text: A presentation will be made by the Vice President of Marketing and Communications on the new branding for Civic Theatres Toronto.

The Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto: 1. Changed the operational name of Civic Theatres Toronto to the name identified in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 15, 2019) from the President and Chief Executive Officer. 2. Authorized the public release of Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Attachment 2 to the report (January 15, 2019) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, Civic Theatres Toronto following the press announcement on January 21, 2019. 3. Requested that City Council legally change the name of Civic Theatres Toronto to the name identified in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 15, 2019) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, Civic Theatres Toronto and amend Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 23, Civic Theatres accordingly. 4.
